10: // ScyllaDBDatacenterSpec defines the desired state of ScyllaDBDatacenter.
11: type ScyllaDBDatacenterSpec struct {
12: 	// metadata controls shared metadata for all pods created based on this spec.
13: 	// +optional
14: 	Metadata *ObjectTemplateMetadata `json:"metadata,omitempty"`
15: 
16: 	// clusterName specifies the name of the ScyllaDB cluster.
17: 	// When joining two DCs, their cluster name must match.
18: 	// This field is immutable.
19: 	ClusterName string `json:"clusterName"`
20: 
21: 	// datacenterName specifies the name of the ScyllaDB datacenter. Used as datacenter name in GossipingPropertyFileSnitch.
22: 	// If empty, it's taken from the 'scylladbdatacenter.metadata.name'.
23: 	// +optional
24: 	DatacenterName *string `json:"datacenterName,omitempty"`
25: 
26: 	// scyllaDB holds a specification of ScyllaDB.
27: 	ScyllaDB ScyllaDB `json:"scyllaDB"`
28: 
29: 	// scyllaDBManagerAgent holds a specification of ScyllaDB Manager Agent.
30: 	// +optional
31: 	ScyllaDBManagerAgent *ScyllaDBManagerAgent `json:"scyllaDBManagerAgent,omitempty"`
32: 
33: 	// imagePullSecrets is an optional list of references to secrets in the same namespace
34: 	// used for pulling any images used by this spec.
35: 	// +optional
36: 	ImagePullSecrets []corev1.LocalObjectReference `json:"imagePullSecrets,omitempty"`
37: 
38: 	// dnsPolicy defines how a pod's DNS will be configured.
39: 	// +optional
40: 	DNSPolicy *corev1.DNSPolicy `json:"dnsPolicy,omitempty"`
41: 
42: 	// dnsDomains specifies a list of DNS domains this cluster is reachable by.
43: 	// These domains are used when setting up the infrastructure, like certificates.
44: 	// +optional
45: 	DNSDomains []string `json:"dnsDomains,omitempty"`
46: 
47: 	// forceRedeploymentReason specifies the latest redeployment reason.
48: 	// Can be used to force a rolling restart of all racks in this DC by providing a unique string.
49: 	// +optional
50: 	ForceRedeploymentReason *string `json:"forceRedeploymentReason,omitempty"`
51: 
52: 	// exposeOptions specifies parameters related to exposing ScyllaDBDatacenter backends.
53: 	// +optional
54: 	ExposeOptions *ExposeOptions `json:"exposeOptions,omitempty"`
55: 
56: 	// rackTemplate provides a template for every rack.
57: 	// Every rack inherits properties specified in the template, unless it's overwritten on the rack level.
58: 	// +optional
59: 	RackTemplate *RackTemplate `json:"rackTemplate,omitempty"`
60: 
61: 	// racks specify the racks in the datacenter.
62: 	Racks []RackSpec `json:"racks"`
63: 
64: 	// disableAutomaticOrphanedNodeReplacement controls if automatic orphan node replacement should be disabled.
65: 	// +optional
66: 	DisableAutomaticOrphanedNodeReplacement *bool `json:"disableAutomaticOrphanedNodeReplacement,omitempty"`
67: 
68: 	// minTerminationGracePeriodSeconds specifies minimum duration in seconds to wait before every drained node is
69: 	// terminated. This gives time to potential load balancer in front of a node to notice that node is not ready anymore
70: 	// and stop forwarding new requests.
71: 	// This applies only when node is terminated gracefully.
72: 	// If not provided, Operator will determine this value.
73: 	// EXPERIMENTAL. Do not rely on any particular behaviour controlled by this field.
74: 	// +optional
75: 	MinTerminationGracePeriodSeconds *int32 `json:"minTerminationGracePeriodSeconds,omitempty"`
76: 
77: 	// minReadySeconds specifies the minimum number of seconds for which a newly created ScyllaDB node should be ready
78: 	// for it to be considered available.
79: 	// When used to control load balanced traffic, this can give the load balancer in front of a node enough time to
80: 	// notice that the node is ready and start forwarding traffic in time. Because it all depends on timing, the order
81: 	// is not guaranteed and, if possible, you should use readinessGates instead.
82: 	// If not provided, Operator will determine this value.
83: 	// +optional
84: 	MinReadySeconds *int32 `json:"minReadySeconds,omitempty"`
85: 
86: 	// readinessGates specifies custom readiness gates that will be evaluated for every ScyllaDB Pod readiness.
87: 	// It's projected into every ScyllaDB Pod as its readinessGate. Refer to upstream documentation to learn more
88: 	// about readiness gates.
89: 	// +optional
90: 	ReadinessGates []corev1.PodReadinessGate `json:"readinessGates,omitempty"`
91: }
